nonBlockingObservations.title: The Open log does not independently observe every pre-charge acquisition
nonBlockingObservations.detail: WalkCall::Open is emitted in enter after the charge and after open() returns. With the supplied late-charge mutation, a successful root duplicate can occur before a failed charge and still emit no Open. Thus the unfunded-root zero-Open assertion and successful-path Descend/Open adjacency do not by themselves prove syscall ordering. The unreadable nested-directory Budget assertion does catch the supplied mutation, as the recorded failing control shows, and all four current call sites correctly defer their effects, so this does not block acceptance.
nonBlockingObservations.suggestedChange: For stronger root-specific regression coverage, record descriptor acquisition at its actual opener call site (or use an injected opener with an independently observed invocation count), and assert that an unfunded root never invokes it. Describe the current trace as successful charged acquisitions rather than a complete syscall trace.
